Episode 246: The Battle for the Mitra Desert (14)
Western part of the Mitra Desert.

Kinzelo and his group were observing the battle from this location. Thanks to the success of Lanke's summoning spell, the stage was set in their favor, and there was no reason for them to eagerly join the battle.

Moreover, every time a battle broke out in the central part, creatures from the sky and aerial fortresses went berserk. Strong fighters like Berakt, Badrei, and Bianca found it challenging to exert their powers in such chaos.
Despite being too far to visually confirm the situation, Kinzelo and his group felt as if they were very close to the action.
"Man... It's fierce. At this rate, I wouldn't be surprised if the entire desert just disappeared off the map," remarked Badrei.
Everyone nodded in agreement.

Lanke, who had previously been elated from his successful summoning, now looked completely changed. This might be because even legendary demons could not handle the monsters that were now appearing on the side of the Vamel Alliance.
The desert vibrated continuously. Previously, only a widespread red glow had stained the sky, but now white beams of light pierced through.
"That's Elona Zipfel... Her magic is unmistakable!"
Cold Jo, instantly recognizing Elona's dominating magic in the sky, began to shiver. It wasn't reverence he felt as a fellow mage but a desire to study her.
"If only I had that so-called Holy Crown the leader mentioned...! If I had that, controlling such monsters would be easy. And, with that power, ruling the world wouldn't be difficult," he mused.
"You grow more delusional by the day. Hmm... Elona Zipfel joining the battle is no mere coincidence. Her goal must be... to destroy the portal."
"Certainly, Sir Berakt."
As they spoke, Sribi suddenly appeared before Kinzelo and his party.

The demons, having absorbed a vast amount of pure energy, now appeared much more robust than before. Their semi-transparent bodies had turned into a deeper hue, and their horns, wings, and muscles had thickened.
"Master Sribi, you've arrived!" Lanke greeted
[Lanke, the flow of the battle is peculiar, isn't it?]
"Is it because Elona Zipfel has appeared?"

[Yes. And until just a moment ago, Jin Runcandel and the freed Plutonian warriors were also on the battlefield. But Jin Runcandel's group did not engage in battle and left the desert. Consequently, Elona Zipfel and the Red Plutonians, who clearly have a grudge against each other, are hardly attacking one another.]
"I see, they must be targeting the portal to Lafrarosa."

[Exactly. They are pouring their attacks solely towards the dimensional rift as if they have some sort of agreement. Can't you see? At a speed hundreds of times faster than what we absorb, vast amounts of power and Red Lightning are being shot into the dimensional rift.]
Understanding the actions of Elona and the enemy clan was not difficult.
Currently, the Vamel Alliance and Lafrarosa are virtually in a state equivalent to public enemies of the influential forces.
"…Great Demon Sribi, what do you think? If they combine their efforts to attack the dimensional rift, would Lafrarosa be destroyed?"

[It would depend on how long that God inside Lafrarosa can hold out. Considering the first energy we felt from him and the description we heard from Orgal, it seems hard to kill her even with all-out attacks from the 4th Aerial Fortress and Elona Zipfel.]
"Ha, you're saying that even if the 4th Aerial Fortress and Elona Zipfel attack relentlessly, it would be hard to kill her? Does that even make sense?"
"It does, Commander Badrei. The attacks entering the portal won't all directly hit Lafrarosa in their original state. There are bound to be losses when passing between dimensions."
Jo answered on behalf of Sribi.
"…But then, why did Jin Runcandel not participate and just leave? Oh, don't tell me he doesn't know that Lafrarosa's portal can be destroyed by external shocks?"
[Who knows? He might have just shown off. By showing a protective stance, it might force the Red Plutonian, us, or Zipfel to deploy more troops.]
"Hmm."
[In my opinion, why Jin Runcandel left isn't the pressing issue. What you need to ponder is whether or not to join forces with the Red Plutonian and Zipfel in destroying the portal, or to abstain.]
Choice.

If the summoned demons were to join in the attack on the Lafrarosa portal, their original goal of buying time could be jeopardized. On the other hand, there was the burden of potentially releasing Lafrarosa in its entirety if they continuously obstructed Elona and the Red Plutonian.
This wasn't a decision that could be made by the individuals currently in the desert.
"Sigh, then we'll discuss and decide with the commander when we return today…"
Just as Berakt replied, a steel dimensional portal formed abruptly among the Kinzelo group. However, this portal looked different, appearing distorted and corroded.
"Has the Commander arrived?"
"The Commander… is here…"
Orgal and Margiella emerged from the portal.
[Hmm, the Red Plutonian Energy Waves are filthy. Even my steel portal is this unstable.]
[Orgal, you seem to be having trouble.]
[I came to test the interference of the Red Plutonian brainwave, Sribi. Fortunately, it's not to the extent that I can't teleport at all.]
The members took some time to explain the current situation to Orgal.
[The story isn't that complicated. We won't participate in the destruction of the Lafrarosa passage.]
Orgal made his decision immediately.
"As expected, leader, a good decision!"
As Margiella smiled and spoke, all members' eyes focused on her.

"Now, let's look back at the actions Master Jin has shown us so far. You know, he always gets what he wants in situations like this, right? No matter how much we or Zipfel, or other Red Plutonian tried to interfere, things always worked out strangely well for him. So, I think it's a foregone conclusion that the demons will come out as hostages."

"Well, Margiella, that seems a bit speculative. But we have often approached things logically and been outplayed by him... Just look at this situation; as soon as Lanke succeeded in summoning, the door to Lafrarosa also opened."
All members agreed with Margiella's words.
In fact, everyone had felt this way all along. Ultimately, Lafrarosa wouldn't be destroyed, and the demons would come out as hostages.

"So, there's no need to incur more resentment towards Master Jin and the demons right now. And, bluntly speaking, even if the Vamel alliance gets stronger by acquiring the demons, Master Jin is someone we can negotiate with. But what about the Red Plutonian? Will we have any offer to make to them once the Mitra desert battle is over?"
There wasn't.

From the start, Kinzelo initiated the battle in the Mitra desert to survive against the Red Plutonian. Moreover, the Red Plutonian had been tormented by the three summoned demons, so they had no reason to let Kinzelo be.
[As always, what we can hope for is watching them fight over the desert and hurt each other as much as possible. And that's a very likely scenario... ]
Orgal looked across the desert as he spoke. As if measured, Elona's magic and the Red Plutonian Energy Waves were dividing the distant sky.
All these immense forces would now be heading towards the Lafrarosa passage.
[So, do Karma, Masarun, and I just need to keep interfering with the Red Plutonian and Elona?]
[Yes, Sribi.]
[Understood. Oh, and earlier, the witch appeared in Masarun's dream and said to tell you something.]
[...Heluram?]
[Yes. She said you have something to receive and give, so visit the abyss.]
Orgal's eyes widened. As far as he knew, there was nothing left unresolved between Heluram and him.
But with such a direct message conveyed, it couldn't be ignored. Because something terrible could happen.
[Understood.]
Meanwhile, at Lafrarosa.

The usual serene and bright atmosphere in Lafrarosa was nowhere to be found. The ever-clear sky was distorted, harboring tumor-like fissures. Immense waves of energy and magic were pouring through them.
The attacks had originated from the desert.
“Damn it, what is this now...?”
“It's magic!”
“Get the Teto brothers, capture the Shaku brothers!”

King Baltirock shouted. Like the other kings, he was guarding the regular soldiers, but upon seeing that the new force, caused by the magic, was pulling Shaku out of the protective barrier, he yelled out.
“Tch!”
Teto lunged and grabbed Shaku. Shaku was unconscious and couldn't reach out to Teto.
A streak of pure white light struck Teto's shoulder. A magic spear from Elona had precisely hit the opening created when he caught Shaku.
Soon, Teto descended back to the ground, safely placing Shaku inside the barrier. Blood oozed from his wounded shoulder, but there was no time to rest.

‘Due to the spatial collapse, the regular soldier brothers can't use their power. Moreover, the injuries, minor and major, among the king brothers, including myself, keep increasing. This way, the domain the God brothers need to protect becomes too vast...!’
Teto, patching up the torn part of the barrier, looked up at Vahn.
Goddess Vahn, she was currently maintaining a massive protective barrier to guard the God Temple. On the surface, she didn't look exhausted, but all her brothers were worried about her.
For several days, the space had been collapsing under relentless external attacks. During this time, Vahn had not rested for a moment, keeping up the barrier.
“Boras brothers, isn't there a way we can assist the God brothers more?”
“For now, it's best if we just don't get more hurt! Once the Kaio brothers finish their treatment, I'll attend to you immediately, so Teto brothers, please wait a bit.”
Boras replied to Teto in this way when, for a moment, Vahn closed her eyes.
Then, after pondering for a few seconds, she looked down at the kings.
“...It seems just defending won't be enough.”
“Goddess Vahn?”
“Brothers, I am going to drop the barrier momentarily. Let them know. We need to show those outside that Lafrarosa isn't just a training log.”
